# QR encoder

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified qrcode-generator 1.4.4 distribution by Kazuhiko Arase (MIT).
Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator/v/1.4.4

Vendored to preserve the dependency-free deployment and generate invite QR images locally; invite links are never sent to a third-party QR service. The library's copyright header is retained. See qrcode.LICENSE.
